summary.text: Trey Martinez Fischer is a Democratic state representative from Texas who represents District 116, served in the seat from 2001 to 2017 and again since 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Trey Martinez Fischer was born in San Antonio, Texas, graduated from the University of Texas at San Antonio and earned a law degree at the University of Texas.
Martinez Fischer held the District 116 seat in the Texas House from 2001 to 2017 and returned to it on January 8, 2019, succeeding Diana Arevalo, a Democrat.
In 2023 and 2024 he was assigned to the Appropriations Committee, the Culture, Recreation, & Tourism Committee (as vice chair) and the Juvenile Justice & Family Issues Committee.
